macro_cross_check.verdict: Protein PASS (-4.6%), portions are right. BAND FAIL CALLED OUT LOUDLY - see band_check. The 38-cal shortfall vs the source traces to one row: the house Hot Italian Sausage row (Johnsonville, 190 cal per 2.5 oz/70 g, i.e. 2.71 cal/g) applied to 454 g RAW per 4 servings. The row does not say whether its 70 g serving is raw or cooked; if it is a cooked-link basis (USDA raw pork Italian sausage runs 3.46 cal/g; the row's own note says it replaced an 82 g/260 cal figure that matches Johnsonville's COOKED-link panel), the honest raw-basis compute is ~460-470 cal/serving and the recipe passes comfortably. NOT resolved here: the row carries a deliberate house correction note and overriding it would be exactly the guess this gate exists to prevent. Flagged for the batch auditor / meal-macro label verification; the recipe should not be retired on this number until the sausage row's basis is pinned.
